direct_total_tat_role: MODEL-PREDICTED TRIP-LEVEL OUTPUT; retain alongside calculated TAT
direct_total_distance_role: MODEL-PREDICTED TRIP-LEVEL OUTPUT; retain alongside calculated distance
direct_average_moving_speed_role: MODEL-PREDICTED TRIP-LEVEL OUTPUT; retain alongside calculated moving speed
calculated_tat_formula: STOP + IDLE + INCHING + ACC + DEC + CRUISE + common physical charging
calculated_distance_formula: STOP + IDLE + INCHING + ACC + DEC + CRUISE phase distances; charging distance = 0 km
calculated_average_moving_speed_formula: (INCHING + ACC + DEC + CRUISE distances) / (INCHING + ACC + DEC + CRUISE times) * 60
